name: IC Interface — 5V, I2C, 5.5V — TSSOP
description: TSSOP surface-mount I2C interface IC cluster featuring 3 tier A parts with 5V and 5.5V ratings across 16-pin and 24-pin package options.
selection_hints: Select when requiring SMD I2C interface ICs rated for 5V or 5.5V.
Choose between TSSOP-16 (4.4x5mm) and TSSOP-24 (4.4x7.8mm) footprint options with 0.65mm pitch.
Pick from representative parts PCA9555PW, PCAL6408APW, or PCAL6416APW.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or non-SMD assembly is required.
The design requires footprint packages other than TSSOP-16 or TSSOP-24.
Operating voltage or interface requirements differ from 5V/5.5V and I2C.
